title: Defiling
author: Dark Sun Engine
description: A defiler's wizard spells drain the life around it: the ground within a cell of the caster (two for 4th- and 5th-level spells) turns to grey ash for the rest of the fight. A defiler casting again from ash it already drained finds less there, and its targets add the spell's level to their saves. Nothing grows on ash, so Entangle and Barkskin don't take anyone standing on it. Preservers, psionics and items leave none. Only creatures are defilers in Dark Sun, so the ash comes from the enemy. Off: the game is DSUN.EXE's, with no ash.
